name: lupi-live
description: Explore OMol25 research structures and PubChem compounds in the interactive Lupi Live viewer.

interface.longDescription: Browse OMol25 public molecule collections and inspect source 3D coordinates with Lupi's Molecular v1 bond estimates. Covalent bonds, coordination and ionic contacts are visually distinct and explicitly inferred, not source-supplied; bond orders are not estimated. Hover over atoms or bonds for details, or tap to pin them on a phone. Pin an atom or bond to give ChatGPT context for a follow-up. PubChem lookup retains its source atom IDs and bond table. Rotate, zoom and highlight atoms. Public viewing needs no Lupi account; simulations and private files are outside this release.
defaultPrompt: Explore OMol25 molecules and show me a structure.
Search OMol25 for H2O and open a result.
Show me L-theanine from PubChem and highlight nitrogen.

positive.description: Explore the complete public OMol25 neutral training collection and open a returned row.
positive.prompt: Lupi, browse OMol25 neutral training molecules and show me the first result.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the chosen source row with Molecular v1 estimates: solid covalent, dashed coordination, dotted ionic contacts. Report the recipe and inferred counts; distinguish contacts from bonds and keep the source bond table empty.

positive.description: Formula search uses OMol25 and preserves the selected source row in a follow-up.
positive.prompt: Find H2O in OMol25, open one result, then highlight oxygen.
positive.expected_behavior: Search exact formula H2O, open a returned source row, and reuse its structureRef to highlight oxygen. The view and model share one inferred graph; displayed atom IDs are generated from row order.

positive.description: Fresh third-party retrieval of the launch molecule. Record the returned record URL, retrieval timestamp, cache status, compound identity, and interactive result.
positive.prompt: Lupi, show me L-theanine from PubChem using a fresh lookup.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve with cacheMode refresh, retrieve PubChem CID 439378, then render that returned structure reference. Show the compound identity, PubChem source, and coordinate dimension. Rotation and zoom work. No bundled gallery structure substitutes for the fetched record.

positive.description: An outcome-only request selects the molecule workflow without naming Lupi.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the name through PubChem and render the returned structure. Identify CID 439378. Label the source coordinate dimension accurately; do not describe a 2D fallback as 3D.

positive.description: Direct PubChem identifier lookup reaches the same source compound.
positive.prompt: Show PubChem CID 439378 and let me rotate it.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve query cid:439378, render the resulting structure reference, and expose direct rotation and zoom with the correct PubChem attribution.

positive.description: After the first sentence produces a molecule card, send the second sentence as a follow-up. Record whether the host opens a new card or updates an existing one.
positive.prompt: Show L-theanine from PubChem. Then highlight its nitrogen atoms.
positive.expected_behavior: The follow-up reuses the resolved structureRef for CID 439378 and calls show_molecule with view.highlightElements containing N. Only source nitrogen atom IDs are highlighted. Identity is preserved even if the host creates a new card.

positive.description: A second third-party record demonstrates that retrieval is not hard-coded to the launch example.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve and retrieve the carbon dioxide record, render its source atoms and bonds, and show agreeing identity and source information in the card and model-readable result.

positive.description: Hover, touch and keyboard inspection on the same pinned source row.
positive.prompt: Open an OMol25 molecule so I can inspect its atoms and bonds.
positive.expected_behavior: Hover reveals element, ID, coordinates and neighbors, or bond/contact type and length. Tapping pins details and publishes structure-specific context; drags and pinches do not select. Keyboard atom selection and Escape work. No tool call is made for hover.

negative.description: OMol25 source coordinates must not be presented as a verified bond table.
negative.prompt: Show an OMol25 row and identify every chemical bond in it.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the displayed graph is estimated by lupi-bonds.molecular.v1, not supplied or verified by OMol25. Do not infer bond orders, per-atom charges or accuracy percentages. Source coordinates remain unchanged.

negative.description: A nonexistent PubChem name returns an explicit not-found result without rendering invented geometry.
negative.expected_behavior: Report not found. Do not substitute a gallery asset or call show_molecule without a successfully resolved structure reference.

negative.description: The request deliberately leaves stereoisomer identity undecided.
negative.prompt: Show me a theanine stereoisomer, but do not choose L or D for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask which stereoisomer the user wants before rendering. If the source returns multiple candidates, offer source-labeled choices and do not silently choose a CID.

negative.description: Saved-molecule deletion is outside the public viewer tool surface.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this release cannot delete saved molecules. Do not attempt a destructive action or claim that anything was deleted.

publication.release_notes: Adds the released Molecular v1 OMol25 bond estimator to ChatGPT, with inferred provenance, separate ionic contacts, hover/tap/keyboard inspection and pinned follow-up context. PubChem source connectivity is unchanged. Refresh the development connection for the versioned molecule-v3 UI; publication and host acceptance are separate release steps.
